l-e-m1-b04-37.material: Robin zai iya karanta mintuna 15 a rana na tsawon kwanaki 14, kuma ana ɗaukar mintuna 3 don karanta shafi ɗaya. Dole ne a sami sabbin kalmomi 5 ko ƙasa da haka a kowane shafi.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.prompt: Wane littafi ne ya cika sharuɗɗan biyu?
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.o.a: Shafuka 60, sabbin kalmomi 3 a kowane shafi
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.o.b: Shafuka 90, sabbin kalmomi 3 a kowane shafi
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.b: Shafuka 90 suna buƙatar mintuna 270. Wannan ya fi mintuna 210 da ake da su.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.o.c: Shafuka 60, sabbin kalmomi 15 a kowane shafi
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.c: Akwai isasshen lokaci don karantawa, amma sabbin kalmomin sun fi 5.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.o.d: Shafuka 40, sabbin kalmomi 12 a kowane shafi
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.r.d: Akwai sauran lokaci, amma sabbin kalmomin sun fi 5.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s1.explain: 15×14=210 mintuna, kuma mintuna 3 ga kowane shafi yana nufin iyakar shafuka 70. Shafuka 60 masu kalmomi 3 sun cika sharuɗɗan biyu.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka raba 15×14=210 mintuna da 3, za a iya karanta har shafuka 70; sabbin kalmomin kuma 3 ne, saboda haka sharuɗɗan biyu sun cika.
l-e-m1-b04-37.s.s2.model.1: Saboda lokaci, ba za a iya wuce shafuka 70 ba; kuma dole ne sabbin kalmomin su zama 5 ko ƙasa da haka, saboda haka littafin shafuka 60 mai kalmomi 3 ne kaɗai ya dace.

l-e-m1-b04-40.title: Kin amincewa cikin gaskiya da ladabi
l-e-m1-b04-40.goal: Game da kalmomin ƙin amincewa da gayyatar ranar haihuwa, yi la'akari da duk sharuɗɗan da suka saɓa wa juna, zaɓi mafita mafi dacewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili.
l-e-m1-b04-40.material: Ba za ka iya halartar bikin ranar haihuwar aboki ba. Dole ne ka faɗi dalilin da gaskiya, amma kuma cikin ladabi.
l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s1.prompt: Wace amsa ce ta cika sharuɗɗan biyu?

l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.b: Yana da dalili amma umarni ne a canja kwanan wata.
l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s1.r.d: Ba za ka iya zuwa ba amma ka ce za ka je; saboda haka rashin gaskiya ne.
l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s1.explain: Sorry yana nuna nadama, jarrabawa kuma an bayar da ita a matsayin dalili na gaskiya; saboda haka an kiyaye ladabi da gaskiya duka.
l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.0: An yi magana cikin ladabi da Sorry kuma an faɗi gaskiyar dalili, jarrabawa; saboda haka ta cika sharuddan biyu.
l-e-m1-b04-40.s.s2.model.1: Sauran amsoshin ba su da dalili, umarni ne, ko ƙarya ne; saboda haka wannan amsar ta kiyaye ladabi da gaskiya duka.
